description: This file defines the EmployeeMembership entity class used in the OrangeHRM system. It maps to the 'hs_hr_emp_member_detail' database table and includes properties and methods for managing employee membership details such as membership type, fees, currency, start date, and renewal date.

classes.name: EmployeeMembership
classes.description: Entity class representing employee membership details linked to an employee and a membership type, including various attributes like fees, currency, and dates.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the membership record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the membership record.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee entity associated with this membership.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with this membership.

methods.name: getMembership
methods.description: Returns the Membership entity associated with this record.

methods.name: setMembership
methods.description: Sets the Membership entity for this record.

methods.name: getSubscriptionPaidBy
methods.description: Returns who paid for the subscription.

methods.name: setSubscriptionPaidBy
methods.description: Sets who paid for the subscription.

methods.name: getSubscriptionCurrency
methods.description: Returns the currency code for the subscription.

methods.name: setSubscriptionCurrency
methods.description: Sets the currency code for the subscription.

methods.name: getSubscriptionCommenceDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the subscription commences.

methods.name: setSubscriptionCommenceDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the subscription.

methods.name: getSubscriptionRenewalDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the subscription is due for renewal.

methods.name: setSubscriptionRenewalDate
methods.description: Sets the renewal date of the subscription.
